facts.fact: According to the StackAdapt-commissioned Ascend2 report, 41% of agencies now lean more heavily into brand-building.
facts.quote: According to the report, 41% of agencies now lean more heavily into brand-building.

facts.fact: According to the report, agencies that align brand and performance goals are 20% more likely to report satisfaction with campaign outcomes.
facts.quote: agencies that align brand and performance goals are 20% more likely to report satisfaction with campaign outcomes.

facts.fact: According to the report, 48% of high performers run campaigns across five or more programmatic channels.
facts.quote: 48% of high performers run campaigns across five or more programmatic channels, compared to just 33% of others.

facts.fact: According to the report, 39% of agencies say AI is now a core part of their workflow.
facts.quote: 39% of agencies say AI is now a core part of their workflow

facts.fact: The research report was conducted by Ascend2 and commissioned by StackAdapt, the vendor whose blog post presents it.
facts.quote: conducted by [Ascend2](https://ascend2.com/) and commissioned by StackAdapt

facts.fact: The article was published on July 3, 2025.
